transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our daily production safety huddle going. I need to walk through the opening number stunt before I can sign off on the final plan. Let's start with rigging, insurance, talent, and fire-safety leads -- please each confirm your current conditions and any concerns so I can make sure everything is reflected accurately. Go ahead.

transcript.text: Maya, before we go further on rigging -- I need to flag a critical update. I completed my rigging review of the installed points after yesterday's load test, and it requires a dual-point harness and exactly 3 meters of unobstructed performer clearance. The current draft still shows a single-point harness and 2-meter clearance, which does not meet the reviewed requirement. I haven't been able to circulate the revised rigging sheet yet, so this hasn't been reflected in the current plan.
